|

Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Construction / Conception et technique
Description de l'entreprise
Our client is a company specialised in technical solutions for construction projects, active across a wide range of sites in Belgium. It relies on an internal engineering team responsible for analysing, optimising, and preparing the technical aspects of projects. To support its development, the organisation is strengthening its design office with a
Dutch-speaking engineer
.
Description de la fonction
Contribute to the
technical analysis of projects
and the preparation of offers
Explore different design approaches and propose suitable technical solutions
Collaborate with internal teams
to assess constraints, risks, and opportunities
Support the preparation of technical documents and project files
Take responsibility for
complete technical studies
related to project design and execution
Provide technical support to operational teams during project start-up and follow-up
Contribute to the continuous improvement of methods, tools, and processes within the design office
Work on projects requiring in-depth technical or structural analysis.
Profil
Civil or industrial engineer
with a strong interest in technical analysis and design
Fluent in Dutch, with a good understanding of English and French
Rigorous, analytical, and comfortable with calculations and modelling
Enjoys teamwork and contributing to varied projects
Motivated to grow in an environment where technique, precision, and collaboration are essential
Compétences linguistiques
Français (atout)

Écrire : Expérimenté - (C1)
Lire : Expérimenté - (C1)
Parler : Expérimenté - (C1)
